entities.summary: Dame Chinyelu Susan "Chi" Onwurah is a British politician who has served as Member of Parliament (MP) for Newcastle upon Tyne Central and West since 2024, and previously for Newcastle upon Tyne Central from 2010 to 2024, when the constituency was abolished. She is a member of the Labour Party. Chi Onwurah was a architects & engineers from Wallsend (b. 1965-04-12, Wallsend). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
